name: Avoid Fate's Gaze

source.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

text: Your past and current enemies may know you by reputation, but spying on you with magic is much more difficult. Whenever you attempt a saving throw against a scrying or effect, you do so at mythic proficiency. Scrying effects that attempt to observe you that don't allow saving throws to resist (such as Clairaudience or Clairvoyance) treat you as if you were Concealed and actively trying to Hide or Sneak unless they are mythic as well.
